turns.t: Hello, doctor! I'm Sinead's sister, I've come along for moral support, and because she'll forget half of what you say. ~
I will not. I'm just nervous. It's the results of my scan, the ovary one.
Don't worry. Let me begin by asking how you've been. Any pain in your tummy?
A dull ache, on the right side, low down, on and off. It comes at the time of my period, and a bit at other times.
How long has that been going on?
Six months, since the last scan.
Any bloating, or heavy bleeding, or bleeding between your periods?
No bloating. Periods are regular. No bleeding in between.
Any pain during sex, or when you open your bowels?
No. None of that.
Any fever, or sudden severe pain?
No. Nothing sudden.
What are you taking?
The combined pill, daily, for three years.
Any other conditions?
Migraines. And I had glandular fever at school.
Who do you live with, do you work?
I live with my sister, and I'm a primary school teacher.
I'm the one who feeds her. ~
The scan shows the cyst on your right ovary has got smaller. Last time it was four centimetres, now it's two and a half. ~
Is that good? ~
Very good. It's a simple, fluid-filled cyst, a functional cyst, with no solid parts, and no worrying features. ~
So it's not cancer? ~
There's nothing about the scan that suggests that. I'd say this is a simple functional ovarian cyst that is resolving.
What about the pain? ~
A cyst of that size can cause an ache. But since it's shrinking, I'd expect it to settle. I can't rule out that some of the ache is from your periods, or something else, so I'd like to examine you.
Fine.
Your tummy is soft, and there's no tenderness except mild discomfort in the right lower side. No masses.
Is that normal? ~
Yes, it's what I'd expect. Do you have any breathlessness, or chest pain?
No, none.
Good. I don't think you need any treatment for the cyst. Keep taking the pill. ~
Do I need another scan? ~
Yes, I'd like to arrange a repeat ultrasound in three months, to make sure it's gone.
Okay. ~
For the ache, you can take paracetamol, and a hot water bottle.
She loves a hot water bottle. ~
If you get sudden severe pain, vomiting, or fainting, go to the emergency department straight away, because a cyst can twist.
I will. ~
I'd like to see you again once the scan's done.
Thank you, doctor. ~
